body: GHerbo is taking things to another level, linking up with Young Thug to film a new music video following his recent concert in Chicago. The two artists were spotted together sparking excitement among fans as anticipation builds around what could be a major collaboration. With G Herbo continuing to make his presence felt in the rap game and Young Thug back connecting with artists and creating new moments, this link-up has hip-hop fans paying attention.
